name: SplitText
label: Split Text
description: Creates a list containing the substrings of a text that is separated by a specified delimiter or regular expression.

fields.name: TextToSplit
fields.label: Text to Split
fields.description: The text value that will be split into parts based on the specified delimiter or pattern.

fields.name: DelimiterType
fields.label: Delimiter Type
fields.description: Specifies how to split the text.

selectOptions.label: Standard
selectOptions.description: Uses predefined delimiters like Tab or New Line.

selectOptions.label: Custom
selectOptions.description: Allows custom delimiters with optional regex support.

fields.name: StandardDelimiter
fields.label: Standard Delimiter
fields.description: The standard delimiter to use when 'Delimiter Type' is 'Standard'.

selectOptions.label: Tab
selectOptions.description: Splits text using the tab character (	).

selectOptions.label: New Line

fields.name: Times
fields.label: Times
fields.description: The number of times to split the text using the standard delimiter.

fields.name: SplitWidth
fields.label: Split Width
fields.description: The width of each substring when 'Delimiter Type' is 'Number of Characters'.

fields.name: CustomDelimiter
fields.label: Custom Delimiter
fields.description: The custom delimiter to use when 'Delimiter Type' is 'Custom'.

fields.name: IsRegularExpression
fields.label: Is Regular Expression
fields.description: Indicates whether the custom delimiter is a regular expression pattern.

fields.name: TextList
fields.label: Text List
fields.description: Returns the list of substrings after splitting the original text.
